### Usage Examples by Stream Type

- **Morning streams**
  - Place a character in the corner of the screen to act as an assistant or secretary.
  - It can also remind viewers to subscribe to your channel.
- **Gaming streams**
  - Even when you're focused on the game, the BOT plays sounds and greets people for you, so you never miss a first-time viewer.
- **Chatting streams**
  - The BOT announces every new viewer, making it a great conversation starter.
  - It also counts the total number of comments in the stream.
- **Singing / karaoke streams**
  - You can set up OBS so sound effects aren't played on stream. You can keep track of your viewers even while singing.
- **Work streams (studying, drawing, editing, etc.)**
  - Even when your hands are full, the BOT reacts to new viewers for you.
